summary: Tested Skipper's Tips (backend + admin/non-admin UI, offline, export/email PDF, create-list/reset interactions) and the Sign-Out unsynced-changes warning at 390x844. All requested features work. Backend: 16/16 new tips tests + 35/35 existing tiers suite pass. Only minor UX issues found.

minor.issue: An empty-string label ("") fails the whole save with 422 (Field min_length=1) whereas whitespace-only labels are silently dropped. Inconsistent but harmless (UI never sends empty labels).

ui_bugs.issue: add() returns true synchronously before commit() resolves, so the typed tip is cleared from add-item-input even when the save is rejected (offline toast or server error); edit dialog likewise closes on failed save. Admin loses typed text. Return/await the commit result instead.
Grammar: with 1 change text reads "You have 1 change that haven't been saved" (should be "hasn't").

issues: 4 action buttons (up/down/edit/delete) per row leave a narrow text column, long tips wrap to 4-5 lines

design_issues.screen: Print view / PDF for Skipper's Tips
issues: Tips render with empty checkboxes '[ ]' like tasks; a numbered/bulleted list would suit tips better
Dialog spans the full viewport width with no side margin/rounded corners

action_items: TipsList: only clear add input / close edit dialog when commit() succeeds
Optional: render tips without checkboxes in PrintView/PDF; add side margin to AlertDialog on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: AccountMenu reads outbox count from localStorage key mbp_outbox_v3 directly (duplicated key string from useBoatStore) - export the constant or expose pending via context
Warning text says changes 'will be lost' but local state/outbox persist in localStorage; they are only discarded if a different account signs in (claimLocal). Wording could be more precise
While online, pending>0 for ~700ms debounce after any edit, so sign-out right after an edit shows the warning briefly - acceptable
Tips edits use last-write-wins full-list PUT; concurrent admin sessions could overwrite each other (single admin, acceptable)
test_credentials: Seeded sessions from /app/memory/test_credentials.md worked (admin/free/pro/beta). Two throwaway free users created for sign-out tests and deleted afterwards.
seed_data_creation: Tips list restored to the main agent's two tips ('Check the forecast twice...', 'Tell someone ashore...'). Pro user's supplied lists were reset via Reset All during testing. 1 email sent to delivered@resend.dev for Skipper's Tips PDF (plus 1 from existing test_tiers_auth pro send test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini runs xdist with --dist loadscope; tips tests are in ONE class so they share a worker and the preserve/restore fixture doesn't race (an earlier multi-class version wiped tips). Verified: GET /api/tips 401 unauth/200 all tiers; PUT /api/admin/tips 401/403/200, strip+drop whitespace, >500 -> 422, >300 items -> 422. UI: admin add/dup/edit/reorder/delete + reload persistence; free/pro/beta read-only identical list; admin manual-offline shows tips-offline-hint + error toast; hard offline reload shows cached tips; Export Current tips print view + pro Email PDF (list_ids ['skippersTips']) 200 and PDF contains tips; create list "skipper's tips" blocked; Reset All leaves tips; sign-out warning count/cancel/confirm->/login and no dialog when synced; To Do flag, Ship's Log email panel, free locks/ad/plan-dialog OK.
